notes.title: COLLECTION of SaGa FINAL FANTASY LEGEND is available now!
notes.content:
Experience the origins of the SaGa series with the COLLECTION of SaGa FINAL FANTASY LEGEND, the first complete port of these hugely popular titles.

This collection includes new enhancements like high-speed mode, and the ability to switch between a vertical or horizontal screen layout. 

■Titles included:
• THE FINAL FANTASY LEGEND
• FINAL FANTASY LEGEND II
•  FINAL FANTASY LEGEND III.

■ New features:
・High Speed Mode: Change your movement speed and the message speed to high-speed.
・Screen settings: Freely switch the screen resolution and display settings between “horizontal” or “vertical” mode. 
・ 4k Compatibility
・Switch languages: Switch between Japanese and English.

notes.title: Notice regarding release of update data
notes.content:
An update has been released today.
(Additional features regarding autosave and other minor fixes)

Regarding the problem discovered in the Steam version that was causing “save”, “autosave” and “quick save” to fail, we have added the following features:

・When a save fails, you can now choose to continue the game instead of going back to the title screen.
・Added an autosave ON/OFF toggle in Config.
　(If saves fail frequently, please turn autosave OFF)

Also, saves may fail if the save location is set to the Cloud, so changing the save location is recommended.

Thank you for continuing to support SaGa Frontier Remastered.

notes.title: Pre-purchase SaGa Frontier Remastered
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that SaGa Frontier Remastered, is now available for pre-purchase on Steam! 

Experience this role-playing adventure as one of the eight heroes, each with their own storyline and goals. With the Free Scenario system, unfold your own unique journey.

Engage in dramatic battles, and use the Glimmer system to gain new skills and carry out combined attacks with your allies!

[h3]New Features Include:[/h3]
[b]・New Main Character, Fuse![/b]
The new main character, Fuse, can be played once certain conditions have been fulfilled. The Fuse scenario features great new tracks from Kenji Ito, and is full of new content. Discover a different side to the other main characters.

[b]・Phantom Cutscenes, Implemented at last[/b]
Several cutscenes that were cut have been added to Asellus's scenario. Delve deeper into the story than before.

[b]・Improved Graphics and Extensive New Features[/b]
Alongside upgraded high-resolution graphics, the UI has been updated and improved. Additional new features have been added, including double-speed mode, making gameplay smoother than ever. 

SaGa Frontier Remastered is available 15th April, 4pm UTC.
